items.html: And it is now clarified how ZA is also bound to Atik Yomin in the aspect of the two lower segments of its Netzah and Hod, which are their very selves, a soul for him within the Daat of ZA; and he is also attached to Him through the lower half of Yesod of Atik Yomin, hidden within the lower half of Tifferet of Arich Anpin, from which are made the Galgalta and Keter of ZA, as we shall explain, G-d willing.
